headline: Bitcoin Exchanges Shed  Million as Price Held Near 83k
narrative: Bitcoin exchanges posted a 24-hour net outflow of  million, equal to 0.186 percent of reserves, a mild accumulation in the spot pipe. The coin held near 83k, up 0.49 percent, with open interest at .44 billion. Options skew at 27.71 showed downside heavily bid into the Oct. 14 expiry, with puts struck at 75k and calls at 92k.
author: jordan
